newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Suharto to fulfill official duties on Friday.
newsitem.headline: Suharto to fulfill official duties on Friday.

text.p: Palace sources said on Friday Indonesia's President Suharto would fulfill his official duties after a normal day's activities the day before.
"He will meet the secretary-general of China's State Council, and meet participants of the armed forces high-ranking officials meeting at the Merdeka Palace," one source told Reuters.
Spot rupiah was quoted at 2,403.5/04.00 at 0200 GMT on Friday, compared with an opening of 2,404.5/05.2.
Palace sources said late on Thursday Suharto was at home and in good health after a normal day's activities, despite renewed rumours on foreign exchange markets that he was ill.
"These rumours are crazy. The president is at home and in good health," one source said.
